title: Iron-dependent formation and structure–property relationship of struvite precipitated from simulated wastewater
content:

Sherif Hefney, Seth Michael Koloski, Philip J. Elias, Damilola Tomi Awotoye, Mohamed Ammar, Hannah Folarin, Lihua Zhang, Matthijs A. van Spronsen, Christie Sayes, Alexander Laskin, Jonas Baltrusaitis
Increasing iron (III) concentration in precursor solution disrupts struvite crystallization. Without iron, distinct struvite microcrystals form. Wastewaver relevant iron concentrations (up to 500 ppm Fe3+) results in amorphous phases.
